game.name: Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow and the Flame
game.desc:
The 1993 Macintosh version, running natively (an unofficial port: the original program translated to C). Uses your own disk image of the game, named PoP2.hfv.
Controls: d-pad or stick to move, A action (grab, strike, careful step), B second button, Start pause, Select time left. Hotkey + B on-screen menu (save states with pictures, levels, cheats, statistics), Hotkey + Y save state, Hotkey + X load the newest, Hotkey + Left rewind, Hotkey + Up one more health, Hotkey + Right 5 more minutes, Hotkey + Start quit.
